newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Oriental Petroleum sets one-for-four rights.
newsitem.headline: Oriental Petroleum sets one-for-four rights.

text.p: Oriental Petroleum Minerals Corp's (OPMC) stockholders approved on Monday a proposal to raise two billion pesos through a one-for-four rights offering.
The rights offer will be accompanied with a warrant that would entitle holders to buy another two shares for every share held, the company said.

OPMC vice chairman James Go told a stockholders meeting proceeds from the offering will finance the company's diversification into power generation, infrastructure, and manufacture of petroleum-based products.
The rights offer and warrants are yet to be approved by the Securities and Exchange Commission and the Philippine Stock Exchange.
